reviews.title: Everything is too small
reviews.text: I got half an hour in and I’m giving up on reading the small text and the small icons. There’s plenty of interesting character designs, I just wish I could see it properly. Everything just feels too small for a mobile screen, especially since my screen is on the lower end in size. I’m sure this game is fun on a bigger screen but until there’s some mobile UI update, it’s not for me.

reviews.title: It’s a good idle game
reviews.text:
I’m not a bot and I’m not sure why their are so many 1 star reviews 
The game is extremely generous and pretty much a f2p can get every char that comes out and their card 
They even buffed the free sr witch are pretty solid when you stellar awaken them 
Really enjoying the game and glad it exist please don’t ever eos 
Graphics are good progression is nice 
It’s faster then most idle games and PvP is capped at LV 200 so its really not crazy whale friendly 
Give the game a go

reviews.title: Gacha (no pity)
reviews.text: After a certain point, becoming stronger is locked behind limit breaks (getting multiple copies of one character) but that’s nearly impossible since there’s so many characters in the game. On top of that, even when there’s a banner there’s no guarantee you’ll get even 2 copies. The pity system in this game is just horrible, it’s not a crazy take to say even FGO has better gacha then Star Savior

reviews.title: Needs to be way more popular
reviews.text: This is a generous, deep, well made game. There is sooo much gacha slop out there, some way more popular than this for reasons I don’t understand. This is a cross between a high-end turn based game like Star Rail (although it’s much newer so obviously not as much content yet, and it isn’t open world) and Umamusume’s deep run-based development. Just give it a try, it’s worth a shot!

reviews.title: Great games
reviews.text:
The devs learn alot from other games, they make this game addictive and some how friendly to f2p gamers. The art is top notch, the options for lobby screen is fantastic, and voice actresses do a very good job. One minus thing is the game’s stability performance. I play on ipad pro 2019 - an old device i know - but for “heavy” games like honkai starrail or arknight endfield, i dont see lags and frozen screen as much as this game, even for some simple screen (captain cabin, event page…).
So pls fix the game performance, see if there are anything you guys can optimize for a smooth game.
; - better than '_star_dive'

reviews.title: Ranked Matches are a joke
reviews.text: Understand that I really do enjoy this game the story, the journeys everything is well done. The ranked matches are a joke though. They take way too long and I almost always get matched up with someone double my level… you should set your defense formation and that’s it. Drafting and eliminating characters takes too long especially when the person you are going against is taking their sweet time.

reviews.title: Overall Stellar, could use some improvements
reviews.text: Elevator pitch, Umamusume but with turn based combat instead of racing. Absolutely love it, if you like either or even both like me, give this a shot! Right now the animated models are a bit janky and background design is a bit lacking, which is preventing me from rating it five stars at the moment. But on a basic game level, it’s truly stellar. Look forward to improvements in the future !
